title: Box, Box, Brenda (68 s, split-screen multichannel thriller)
logline: Theo is leading the night race and Brenda has abandoned her cart: PushOwl chases her through push, email and SMS while a rival chases him, and a WhatsApp discount wins her back as he takes the flag.
joke: The stakes are 300 km/h and a championship, and the team radio is about one customer's cart; PushOwl closes the sale faster than the race ends.
angle: PushOwl is a multichannel retention platform: web push, email, SMS and WhatsApp work together, automatically, until the order comes back.

story.hook: 300 km/h, the commentator calls the hunt, and Dana's first call is about Theo's candle store: Brenda just abandoned her cart.
story.setup: Theo: it's on autopilot. A web push lands; Brenda flicks it away (Later.).
story.build: Split screen: the email goes unopened, the SMS gets a Nope., while Castell closes to half a second and draws alongside.
story.turn: Box, box. At the pit stop Marcus says: Let's send a WhatsApp message. She'll bite.
story.payoff: Ten percent? Fine. Brenda orders as Theo overtakes and wins: the race and the order.
story.cta: My ecommerce store sells while I race. Thanks to PushOwl, the omnichannel marketing platform that works while I'm busy racing. Sign up free on Shopify.
story.button: Who's Brenda? One more valuable customer PushOwl got me. Brenda lights the candle.
